items.headline: Flood Watch issued November 18 at 1:53PM PST until November 19 at 6:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Los Angeles County.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall may result in significant flooding of
roads and other low-lying areas, heavy flows in creeks and canyons,
rockslides, mudslides, and debris flows in recent burn scars.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Rain rates up to 1 inch per hour are expected, especially in the
mountains.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 18 at 11:28AM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 6 to 9 feet with dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Thursday to 9 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large
breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats near shore. Pooling of sea
water is possible around high tide at beach and harbor areas
that is uncommon with normal tidal ranges. Enhanced beach
erosion is also possible. No significant damage is expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor coastal flooding may occur near
early morning high tide. Additional hazardous surf and coastal
flooding isues are expected next week.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 18 at 1:07PM PST until November 19 at 9:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions. Local gale force wind gusts to
35 kt possible Thursday night.


* WHERE...Inner waters from Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA
including Santa Catalina and Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 9 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
